---
- name: Configure NAT egress on node1 for the private LAN (node2, node3)
  hosts: router
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Assign LAN address and configure source NAT masquerade on VyOS
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template
        configure
        set interfaces ethernet eth1 address {{ router_lan_ip }}/24
        set nat source rule 100 outbound-interface name eth0
        set nat source rule 100 source address {{ lan_cidr }}
        set nat source rule 100 translation address masquerade
        commit
        save
        exit
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: vyos_nat
      changed_when: "'No configuration changes' not in vyos_nat.stdout"

    - name: Show resulting NAT source rules
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template
        configure
        run show nat source rules
        run show interfaces ethernet eth1
        exit
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: vyos_show
      changed_when: false

    - name: Print VyOS NAT/interface state
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: vyos_show.stdout_lines

- name: Address node2/node3 on the private LAN and route egress via node1
  hosts: lan_hosts
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Check if eth1 NetworkManager profile already exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ifcfg-eth1
      register: eth1_ifcfg

    - name: Create eth1 connection profile with static private-LAN address and default route via node1
      ansible.builtin.command:
        argv:
          - nmcli
          - connection
          - add
          - type
          - ethernet
          - ifname
          - eth1
          - con-name
          - eth1
          - ipv4.addresses

          - ipv4.gateway

          - ipv4.route-metric

          - ipv4.method
          - manual
          - ipv6.method
